country: Territory of the Wallis and Futuna Islands
Territoire des Iles Wallis et Futuna

fields.climate: tropical; hot, rainy season (November to April); cool, dry season (May to October); rains 250-300 cm per year (80% humidity); average temperature 26.6 degrees Celsius
fields.farm: coconuts, breadfruit, yams, taro, bananas; pigs, goats; fish
fields.languages: Wallisian (indigenous Polynesian language) 58.9%, Futunian 30.1%, French (official) 10.8%, other 0.2%

system.text: parliamentary democracy (Territorial Assembly); overseas collectivity of France
